HOMS_ASSESS.generic_audience: South African independent-school academic leaders, assessment coordinators and educators
HOMS_ASSESS.proof_summary: Eight Grade 12 Term 3 subject packs with separate memoranda, source-grounded papers, embedded media and educator approval boundaries.
HOMS_ASSESS.public_hook: One curriculum spine should not produce eight identical-looking papers. Watch HOMS change the assessment architecture with the subject.
HOMS_ASSESS.public_cta: Review the tight-eight proof and request one subject-and-grade pilot.

EVIDEX_PACK.generic_audience: South African NGO, NPO, M&E, grant and programme teams
EVIDEX_PACK.proof_summary: A controlled messy-input-to-evidence-pack case with mapped claims, provenance, human review, delivery state and business telemetry.
EVIDEX_PACK.public_hook: Your funder wants proof. The proof is spread across folders, spreadsheets and email. Evidex turns that evidence mess into a review-ready pack.
EVIDEX_PACK.public_cta: Review the golden case and nominate one bounded evidence-pack pilot.

HOMS_LEARN.registry_lineage_note: Wave 4 used SOPHIA_LEARN for the combined guided-learning hypothesis; DIO now projects that evidence into canonical HOMS_LEARN.
HOMS_LEARN.generic_audience: South African schools, tutors, extra-class providers and education publishers
HOMS_LEARN.proof_summary: A Grade 10 Physical Sciences Term 3 Motion companion now connects a guide, practical, worksheet, mini-assessment, memoranda, eight meaningful visuals, captions and a 2:06 lesson. Subject-expert approval remains the commercial release gate.
HOMS_LEARN.public_hook: One curriculum spine should drive the explanation, activity, worksheet, assessment, memo and optional video lesson.
HOMS_LEARN.public_cta: Nominate one subject, grade, term and topic for a controlled companion-pack pilot.

SOPHIA_REVIEW.generic_audience: Postgraduate students, supervisors, writing centres and research groups
SOPHIA_REVIEW.proof_summary: Grounded Gemini reviewer commentary, technical citation audit and claim-to-source ledger with human approval and academic-integrity boundaries.
SOPHIA_REVIEW.public_hook: Academic AI should show an author what to strengthen, not write the work for them.

VAMP_ACADEMIC.generic_audience: Academic staff, HR administrators, department heads and performance coordinators
VAMP_ACADEMIC.proof_summary: A controlled private proof mapped 190 evidence records to performance objectives, retained review candidates and exposed evidence gaps without making a rating decision.
VAMP_ACADEMIC.public_hook: Performance review panic starts when evidence was never collected as evidence.
VAMP_ACADEMIC.public_cta: Request one task-agreement and evidence snapshot pilot.

DIO_CAPITAL.generic_audience: seed, early-stage, strategic and venture-studio investors evaluating governed AI infrastructure and repeatable product creation
DIO_CAPITAL.proof_summary: CapitalRoom compiles manifest-bound architecture, operational, refusal and product proof while preserving unearned commercial claims as false.
DIO_CAPITAL.public_hook: One governed organism can compose many evidence-bound product incarnations without pretending every registered product is already commercially proven.
DIO_CAPITAL.public_cta: Review the CapitalRoom and request a governed diligence conversation.
